entities.summary: Sebastian Gemkow is a German lawyer and politician of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) who has been serving as State Minister of Science and as State Minister of Justice (2014–2019) in the governments of successive Minister-Presidents Stanislaw Tillich (2014–2018) and Michael Kretschmer. Since 2009, he has been a member of the Landtag of the Free State of Saxony, the state's parliament.
